scope: Bounded interface definition using existing typed WG layers and declared finite/RH instances; not universal realization, a physical source constructor or a general dependent-syntax compiler.

validity.formal: Universe-indexed safe Cubical Agda judgements in the named source modules and admitted dependencies; evidence records exact theorem, premises, scope and source hashes.
validity.analytic: Owner-qualified classical mathematical arguments with declared standard analytic premises, domains, topology and normalization; finite tests are not analytic proofs.
validity.cross_metatheory: Keep evidence policies distinct. A shared interface record does not supply a translation/equivalence between classical carriers and Cubical types.
validity.answer_insertion: An expected result alone is not a realization. Require actual source operation, intermediate maps and witnesses. Imported laws are allowed only with explicit provenance, not relabelled as native-generated laws.

source_rules.policy: Supplied constructor/compute/metric/clock/normalization/selector data are part of the source record. Claim native generation only with an actual source-rule trace and its preservation evidence.
source_rules.compiler_boundary: CompileDomain assembles the supplied compute operation, admission evidence and law proof at the same retained request index. It does not derive category laws or discover a native constructor.

composition.maps: Actual map composition at matching intermediate types/domains; check every operation square, not only the final composite.
composition.histories: Layer2.join concatenates witnessed histories with matching indexed endpoints, units and associativity, retaining states and witnesses.
composition.original_relation: Folding joined histories into one original relation witness additionally requires supplied Composition; two Boolean flips refute universal folding.
composition.presentations: Retained Sigma totals and certified presentation changes are WG operations. Pi sections are distinct. Carry selector phase, preceding package, membership witness and recovery.
composition.universe_levels: A fixed instance uses declared levels; reifying whole packages may raise a universe. Do not flatten all package levels into one undeclared Type.

identity.complete: Retain source values, indices, occurrence/provenance marks, histories and attachments required by the source; equality of a scalar or terminal recorder is not complete identity.
identity.task: Equality of observations AND availability guards after every licensed finite continuation in the frozen context/resource policy; quotient admission requires a congruence.
identity.relation_ideals: I and I^2 apply only to the separately admitted multiplicative typed recorder/path-algebra source. They are not kernels of arbitrary scalar readers or counts of WG steps. No RH/137-slot binding is inferred.

dependent_transport.signature: For a fixed Layer1 relation Witness(s,t), supply Payload(s):Type_l and move(w):Payload(s)->Payload(t). Walk the retained history; execute(join h k)=execute(k) o execute(h).
dependent_transport.path_specialization: When relation witnesses are paths and movement is actual dependent transport, reuse Layer3 agreement with composite-path transport and its naturality at the stated scope.
dependent_transport.index_retention: Compile request(i) becomes response(i,compute(i)); i remains the request index. Relabelling by the output is not dependent transport.
not_supplied: all-dimensional simplicial coherence for arbitrary boundaries
global sections of arbitrary payload families

completion.finite_pilot: Finite typed requests and retained histories; no analytic completion imported into Boolean/category execution.
completion.RH: Use the existing induced Schwartz Frechet spaces E_r=U S(R), E_s=V E_r and strong anti-duals with endpoints and explicit normalized log Fourier. Native/Fourier distinctions, source archives and continuation contexts survive.
completion.scope: Continuity/density/limit evidence required at every completion edge; raw combs are not ordinary log-tempered or Hilbert states.

pilot_bindings.operation: supplied dependent compute and admission policy
pilot_bindings.laws: Boolean by cases; category laws supplied
pilot_bindings.transport: retained request index and typed law-history; multi-step native binding still requires example audit

pilot_bindings.operation: retained history join and supplied dependent action
pilot_bindings.scope: existing finite-history/path specialization, not all-dimensional coherence

pilot_bindings.operation: source-specific native actions, typed analytic charts and scoped continuation witnesses
pilot_bindings.laws: declared source matrices plus imported analysis; no RH truth seed
pilot_bindings.transport: complete archives versus task-specific readers; stagewise overlap reviewed
